# Stage B protocol (declared before any Stage B training)

Everything here was fixed before the first search trial was run. Results are produced only by
`run_stage_b.py` and written to `results/phase3/<scenario>/`; nothing in a report may come from anywhere else.

## Data
* `data/phase3/<scenario>/` (local-mean target), generated by `build_phase3_dataset.py` with its defaults
  (6 runs per (user count, ACIR) point, 600 slots of 0.5 s, base seed 1000 + per-scenario offset).
  The channel model is not changed to rescue a result.
* Supplementary datasets: `<scenario>_instantaneous` (faded target) and `<scenario>_nosinr` (sinr channel zeroed).

## Hyperparameter search (validation only)
* Grid: hidden size {64, 96, 128} x learning rate {1e-3, 3e-4} x LSTM layers {1, 2} = 12 configs.
  Fixed for all: batch 64, no dropout, no weight decay, gradient clip 1.0, up to 120 epochs, early stopping
  (patience 12) on validation loss.
* Search seed: 42 only. Selection: lowest **validation MAE in dB**; ties go to the smaller hidden size, fewer
  layers, larger learning rate. The search code receives only train/validation arrays.
* Every trial is logged (`search/trials.jsonl`, `search/trials.json`).

## Final training (test split evaluated once per config/seed)
* The single selected config is retrained with seeds **42, 43, 44** per scenario.
* After the test split has been evaluated, the grid is closed: no re-runs with new settings. The driver refuses
  to write into an existing results directory.

## Gates (fixed constants, never changed after results)
* Prototype gate: skill vs persistence >= 0.15. Final gate: skill >= 0.05 vs the best of persistence,
  10-slot linear-power moving average and linear AR(10) (fitted on train).
* Both are evaluated on the **mean test MAE over the three seeds** (skill = 1 - mean MAE / baseline MAE), per
  scenario. Every seed, the mean and the sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) are reported. A failed gate is
  reported as failed.
* The Transformer is run only if the prototype gate fails on the mean.

## Supplementary runs
* Instantaneous-target and sinr-ablation datasets: the chosen config, seed 42, run once each, no separate
  search. Single seed, so their gates are informational.

## Outputs per scenario
`summary.json` (aggregate, gates, baselines, every seed), `search/`, `final/seed_<s>/` (summary, checkpoint,
test predictions), `training_curves.png`, `actual_vs_predicted.png`, `supplementary/<variant>/`. Each JSON carries
`run_info` (seed, library versions, torch threads, git SHA and dirty flag, command line) and the dataset's
SHA-256 hashes.
